One question, several ways of listening

“Why is our new range not taking off?”

  • Social listeningLittle talk about it, and mostly about the price.
  • Audience listeningThe people talking about it are not the intended target.
  • Influence listeningNo voice in the category has picked it up yet.
  • Search listeningSearches are about a format the range does not have.
  • AI listeningAI assistants recommend two competitors.

Our readA format and relay problem, not an awareness one: launch the format people search for, and hand it to the voices the target already follows.
